messages:
Mara: Heads-up 10am sync topic: saved-query scope confusion keeps coming up in support. People pin a filter in a per-route view and expect it to apply everywhere. We need a minimal UX and an API tweak to make scope explicit in saved queries.
Jin: Agree. Two UI parts: 1) a tiny scope badge next to saved query name (verb: Route / Model / Org) 2) an optional inline hint when you first pin. Badge should be 1 word + icon.
Olivia: On the backend, saved-query proto should carry: `scope`, `scope_id`, and `display_hint` (short string) so console doesn't need extra lookups. That also helps support.
Raj: Telemetry: emit `console.savedquery.apply` & `console.savedquery.save` with `scope` and `origin` (user vs import). Also track whether the user toggled "apply to all routes" after seeing the badge. Sample event payload in logs: ```{ "event":"console.savedquery.save","user":"u_32","scope":"route","route":"r_14","t":1715560000 }```
Jin: UX experiment proposal: variant A = badge only, B = badge + hover tooltip, C = badge + one-time inline nudge when pinning (dismissible). Rollout plan: 5% A, 45% B, 50% C for two weeks. Measure: reduction in support threads and increase in explicit scope-change clicks.
Mara: For copy please keep it short: badge label options: "Route", "Model", "Org". Tooltip candidate: "Applies only to this route. Use the menu to save globally." Inline nudge: "Saved to this route. Save globally to reuse across routes."
Olivia: API lexical: saved_query.display_hint should be <= 80 chars. If present console shows cost/quota hint line under tooltip if `quota_delta` present: e.g. "+~12 tokens/req". We'll add `quota_delta` to the PR.
Raj: We'll add telemetry flags for experiment cohorts and store `experiment_variant` in events so analytics can compare cohorts.
Jin: Frontend checklist: render badge (color token + icon), hook hover tooltip, show inline nudge on pin, respect `display_hint` and `quota_delta` from API. Add a feature flag `console.savedquery.scope_nudge`.
ops-bot: PR created: platform/saved-query-scope-quota-props (#1987) CI passing :white_check_mark:
Mara: Lovely. Jin, can you mock the 3 variants by EOD? Raj, can you draft the event schema and dashboards we'll need to evaluate? Olivia, ping when backend PR ready for review.
Jin: On it.
Raj: Drafting now, will post a short list of KPIs in #devex by lunchtime.
Olivia: PR ready for review in 30m.
ops-bot: Deployed feature-flag `console.savedquery.scope_nudge` to staging.
